BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: III
BRANCH: CIVIL   SESSION : MO/2018

SUBJECT : CE3007 BUILDING MATERIAL & CONSTRUCTION

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Identify the characteristics of a good building stone. [2.5]
 (b) Discuss the various preservation methods of building stones. [2.5]


Q2 (a) Identify the types of stones you would recommend for the following types of work:
heavy  engineering  works,  coastal  building,  buildings  in  industrial  areas,  arches,  facia
works in buildings, fire resistant structures, concrete aggregate, railway ballast.
[2.5]
 (b) Describe the method of performing Indian Standard Test on Weathering for stones. [2.5]


Q3 (a) Describe the different processes of moulding and drying of clay in brick manufacturing. [5]


Q4 (a) Identify the characteristics of a good clay brick. [2]
 (b) Describe the process of performing Compressive Strength Test on bricks. [3]


Q5 (a) Identify the different raw materials of cement manufacturing, their function and their
approximate percentages.
[2.5]
 (b) Describe the process of manufacturing Low Heat Portland Cement, its properties and its
uses.
[2.5]


Q6 (a) Describe the manufacturing process of Low Burning Variety of Gypsum. [2]
 (b) Identify the characteristics of a good mortar. [3]
